verses.t: The Most Merciful
verses.pickthall: The Beneficent
verses.yusufAli: (Allah) Most Gracious
verses.rodwell: The God of MERCY
verses.sale: The Merciful

verses.t: Taught the Qur'an
verses.pickthall: Hath made known the Qur'an
verses.yusufAli: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an
verses.rodwell: hath taught the Koran
verses.sale: hath taught his servant the Koran

verses.t: Created man
verses.pickthall: He hath created man
verses.yusufAli: He has created man
verses.rodwell: Hath created man
verses.sale: He created man

verses.t: [And] taught him eloquence
verses.pickthall: He hath taught him utterance
verses.yusufAli: He has taught him speech (and intelligence)
verses.rodwell: Hath taught him articulate speech
verses.sale: He hath taught him distinct speech

verses.t: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation
verses.pickthall: The sun and the moon are made punctual
verses.yusufAli: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed
verses.rodwell: The Sun and the Moon have each their times
verses.sale: The sun and the moon run their courses according to a certain rule

verses.t: And the stars and trees prostrate
verses.pickthall: The stars and the trees prostrate
verses.yusufAli: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration
verses.rodwell: And the plants and the trees bend in adoration
verses.sale: And the vegetables which creep on the ground, and the trees submit to his disposition

verses.t: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
verses.pickthall: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure
verses.yusufAli: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice)
verses.rodwell: And the Heaven, He hath reared it on high, and hath appointed the balance
verses.sale: He also raised the heaven; and He appointed the balance

verses.t: That you not transgress within the balance
verses.pickthall: That ye exceed not the measure
verses.yusufAli: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance
verses.rodwell: That in the balance ye should not transgress
verses.sale: that ye should not transgress in respect to the balance

verses.t: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance
verses.pickthall: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof
verses.yusufAli: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance
verses.rodwell: Weigh therefore with fairness, and scant not the balance
verses.sale: Wherefore observe a just weight; and diminish not the balance

verses.t: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures
verses.pickthall: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures
verses.yusufAli: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures
verses.rodwell: And the Earth, He hath prepared it for the living tribes
verses.sale: And the earth hath He prepared for living creatures

verses.t: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
verses.pickthall: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees
verses.yusufAli: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates)
verses.rodwell: Therein are fruits, and the palms with sheathed clusters
verses.sale: Therein are various fruits, and palm-trees bearing sheaths of flowers

verses.t: And grain having husks and scented plants
verses.pickthall: Husked grain and scented herb
verses.yusufAli: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants
verses.rodwell: And the grain with its husk, and the fragrant plants
verses.sale: and grain having chaff, and leaves

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery
verses.pickthall: He created man of clay like the potter's
verses.yusufAli: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery
verses.rodwell: He created man of clay like that of the potter
verses.sale: He created man of dried clay like an earthen vessel

verses.t: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire
verses.pickthall: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire
verses.yusufAli: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke
verses.rodwell: And He created the djinn of pure fire
verses.sale: But He created the genii of fire clear from smoke

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which then of the bounties, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets
verses.pickthall: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests
verses.yusufAli: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests
verses.rodwell: He is the Lord of the East, He is the Lord of the West
verses.sale: He is the Lord of the east, and the Lord of the west

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side]
verses.pickthall: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet
verses.yusufAli: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together
verses.rodwell: He hath let loose the two seas which meet each other
verses.sale: He hath let loose the two seas, that they meet each another

verses.t: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses
verses.pickthall: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other)
verses.yusufAli: Between them is a Barrier which they do not transgress
verses.rodwell: Yet between them is a barrier which they overpass not
verses.sale: Between them is placed a bar which they cannot pass

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: From both of them emerge pearl and coral
verses.pickthall: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone
verses.yusufAli: Out of them come Pearls and Coral
verses.rodwell: From each he bringeth up pearls both great and small
verses.sale: From them are taken forth unions and lesser pearls

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains
verses.pickthall: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners
verses.yusufAli: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains
verses.rodwell: And His are the ships towering up at sea like mountains
verses.sale: His also are the ships, carrying their sails aloft in the sea, like mountains

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: Everyone upon the earth will perish
verses.pickthall: Everyone that is thereon will pass away
verses.yusufAli: All that is on earth will perish
verses.rodwell: All on the earth shall pass away
verses.sale: Every creature which liveth on the earth is subject to decay

verses.t: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
verses.pickthall: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory
verses.yusufAli: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour
verses.rodwell: But the face of thy Lord shall abide resplendent with majesty and glory
verses.sale: But the glorious and honourable countenance of thy Lord shall remain for ever

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter
verses.pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power
verses.yusufAli: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)
verses.rodwell: To Him maketh suit all that is in the Heaven and the Earth. Every day doth some new work employ Him
verses.sale: Unto him do all creatures which are in heaven and earth make petition: Every day is He employed in some new work

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: We will attend to you, O prominent beings
verses.pickthall: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn)
verses.yusufAli: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds
verses.rodwell: We will find leisure to judge you, O ye men and djinn
verses.sale: We will surely attend to judge you, O men and genii, at the last day

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah]
verses.pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction
verses.yusufAli: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass
verses.rodwell: O company of djinn and men, if ye can overpass the bounds of the Heavens and the Earth, then overpass them. But by our leave only shall ye overpass them
verses.sale: O ye collective body of genii and men, if ye be able to pass out of the confines of heaven and earth, pass forth: Ye shall not pass forth but by absolute power

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves
verses.pickthall: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape
verses.yusufAli: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have
verses.rodwell: A bright flash of fire shall be hurled at you both, and molten brass, and ye shall not defend yourselves from it
verses.sale: A flame of fire without smoke, and a smoke without flame shall be sent down upon you; and ye shall not be able to defend yourselves therefrom

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil
verses.pickthall: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide
verses.yusufAli: When the sky is rent asunder, and it becomes red like ointment
verses.rodwell: When the Heaven shall be cleft asunder, and become rose red, like stained leather
verses.sale: And when the heaven shall be rent in sunder, and shall become red as a rose, and shall melt like ointment

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn
verses.pickthall: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin
verses.yusufAli: On that Day no question will be asked of man or Jinn as to his sin
verses.rodwell: On that day shall neither man nor djinn be asked of his sin
verses.sale: On that day neither man nor genius shall be asked concerning his sin

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet
verses.pickthall: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet
verses.yusufAli: (For) the sinners will be known by their marks: and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet
verses.rodwell: By their tokens shall the sinners be known, and they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet
verses.sale: The wicked shall be known by their marks; and they shall be taken by the forelocks, and the feet, and shall be cast into hell

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: This is Hell, which the criminals deny
verses.pickthall: This is hell which the guilty deny
verses.yusufAli: This is the Hell which the Sinners deny
verses.rodwell: This is Hell which sinners treated as a lie
verses.sale: This is hell, which the wicked deny as a falsehood

verses.t: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree]
verses.pickthall: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water
verses.yusufAli: In its midst and in the midst of boiling hot water will they wander round
verses.rodwell: To and fro shall they pass between it and the boiling water
verses.sale: They shall pass to and fro between the same and hot boiling water

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens
verses.pickthall: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens
verses.yusufAli: But for such as fear the time when they will stand before (the Judgment Seat of) their Lord, there will be two Gardens
verses.rodwell: But for those who dread the majesty of their Lord shall be two gardens
verses.sale: But for him who dreadeth the tribunal of his Lord, are prepared two gardens

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: Having [spreading] branches
verses.pickthall: Of spreading branches
verses.yusufAli: Containing all kinds (of trees and delights)
verses.rodwell: With o'erbranching trees in each
verses.sale: Planted with shady trees

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: In both of them are two springs, flowing
verses.pickthall: Wherein are two fountains flowing
verses.yusufAli: In them (each) will be two Springs flowing (free)
verses.rodwell: In each two fountains flowing
verses.sale: In each of them shall be two fountains flowing

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds
verses.pickthall: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs
verses.yusufAli: In them will be Fruits of every kind, two and two
verses.rodwell: In each two kinds of every fruit
verses.sale: In each of them shall there be of every fruit two kinds

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low
verses.pickthall: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand
verses.yusufAli: They will recline on Carpets, whose inner linings will be of rich brocade: the Fruit of the Gardens will be near (and easy of reach)
verses.rodwell: On couches with linings of brocade shall they recline, and the fruit of the two gardens shall be within easy reach
verses.sale: They shall repose on couches, the linings whereof shall be of thick silk interwoven with gold: And the fruit of the two gardens shall be near at hand to gather

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni
verses.pickthall: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them
verses.yusufAli: In them will be (Maidens), chaste, restraining their glances, whom no man or Jinn before them has touched
verses.rodwell: Therein shall be the damsels with retiring glances, whom nor man nor djinn hath touched before them
verses.sale: Therein shall receive them beauteous damsels, refraining their eyes from beholding any besides their spouses: Whom no man shall have deflowered before them, neither any genius

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: As if they were rubies and coral
verses.pickthall: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone
verses.yusufAli: Like unto Rubies and coral
verses.rodwell: Like jacynths and pearls
verses.sale: Having complexions like rubies and pearls

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: Is the reward for good [anything] but good
verses.pickthall: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness
verses.yusufAli: Is there any Reward for Good - other than Good
verses.rodwell: Shall the reward of good be aught but good
verses.sale: Shall the reward of good works be any other than good

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens
verses.pickthall: And beside them are two other gardens
verses.yusufAli: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens
verses.rodwell: And beside these shall be two other gardens
verses.sale: And besides these there shall be two other gardens

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: Dark green [in color]
verses.pickthall: Dark green with foliage
verses.yusufAli: Dark-green in colour (from plentiful watering)
verses.rodwell: Of a dark green
verses.sale: Of a dark green

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: In both of them are two springs, spouting
verses.pickthall: Wherein are two abundant springs
verses.yusufAli: In them (each) will be two Springs pouring forth water in continuous abundance
verses.rodwell: With gushing fountains in each
verses.sale: In each of them shall be two fountains pouring forth plenty of water

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates
verses.pickthall: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate
verses.yusufAli: In them will be Fruits, and dates and pomegranates
verses.rodwell: In each, fruits and the palm and the pomegranate
verses.sale: In each of them shall be fruits, and palm-trees, and pomegranates

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: In them are good and beautiful women
verses.pickthall: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful
verses.yusufAli: In them will be fair (Companions), good, beautiful
verses.rodwell: In each, the fair, the beauteous ones
verses.sale: Therein shall be agreeable and beauteous damsels

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: Fair ones reserved in pavilions
verses.pickthall: Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions
verses.yusufAli: Companions restrained (as to their glances), in (goodly) pavilions
verses.rodwell: With large dark eyeballs, kept close in their pavilions
verses.sale: Having fine black eyes; and kept in pavilions from public view

verses.t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny
verses.rodwell: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain deny? [RODWELL: Which, etc]
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of your Lord's benefits will ye ungratefully deny

verses.t: Untouched before them by man or jinni
verses.pickthall: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them
verses.yusufAli: Whom no man or Jinn before them has touched
verses.rodwell: Whom man hath never touched, nor any djinn
verses.sale: Whom no man shall have deflowered, before their destined spouses, nor any genius

verses.t: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
